DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 読書会の準備についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about preparing for the reading group?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達の本には、読む所に線が引いてあります。ここで借りる本にも同じ線を書けば便利だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人私物の下線を借用本にも書こうと思ったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend's book has lines under the parts to read. I thought it would be convenient to draw the same lines in the book I borrow here.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought of copying underlining from your friend's own book into a borrowed book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 借りた本へ書き込まず、別の紙などで記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't write in borrowed books; keep a record on separate paper or something similar.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。まだ借りていません。友達の私物の使い方を、図書館の本にも当てはめていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未借用で私物ルールを貸出本へ当てたと認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I haven't borrowed it yet. I was applying the way my friend uses their own property to library books too.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that you have not borrowed it yet and were applying personal-property rules to a loan book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な箇所は、ご自身のメモに残せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can record the relevant passages in your own notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 章の題名とページをメモします。でも、版が違えばページも違うので、番号だけを全員へ送らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 章題とページを別紙に記録し異版へ番号のみ送らないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll note the chapter title and page. But pages may differ between editions, so I'll avoid sending everyone only a page number.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will record chapter titles and pages separately and not send only numbers to people using other editions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本の題名や版の情報も確認されるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would be good to check the book title and edition details too.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認します。友達の線を誰もが読むべき所と決めず、読書会で相談する候補として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 版も確認し友人下線を全員必読ではなく候補とする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. Rather than decide the parts my friend underlined are required reading for everyone, I'll suggest them as options to discuss in the group.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the edition and treat your friend's underlining as suggestions rather than required reading for everyone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 借りる前に、本の状態もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the book's condition before borrowing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。すでに線がある本を見つけても、自分で消したり追加したりせず知らせます。私のメモは別に持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既存線があっても自己消去追加せず報告し別メモを持つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Even if I find a book with existing underlining, I'll report it instead of erasing it or adding more myself. I'll keep my own notes separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will report existing lines without erasing or adding them, and keep separate notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本を大切に扱ってくださりありがとうございます。それでは、読書会の準備をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for treating the books carefully. Enjoy preparing for the reading group.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 服用の記録について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss your medication record?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昼に飲み忘れを思い出しました。メモへ十二時と書きましたが、その時に飲んだわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十二時は飲忘れを思い出した時刻で服用時刻ではないと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: At noon I remembered I'd missed a dose. I wrote twelve o'clock in my notes, but that doesn't mean I took it then.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that twelve o'clock was when you remembered the missed dose, not when you took it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際の服用と、思い出した時刻を分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me separately when you actually took it and when you remembered.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いつもは朝に飲む薬です。今日はまだ飲んでいません。十二時の記録は気づいた時刻だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通常朝服用で本日未服用と明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's medicine I usually take in the morning. I haven't taken it yet today. The twelve-o'clock entry is only the time I noticed.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Clearly state that you usually take it in the morning and have not taken it today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 薬と処方の情報を確認して、今回の対応を相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the medication and prescription information and discuss what to do this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋を持って来ました。前に別の薬で聞いた方法を、今回も同じと思って実行してはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋を示し他薬で聞いた対応を未転用と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought the bag. I haven't assumed the advice I heard for another medicine before applies this time and acted on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the bag and say that you have not applied advice for a different medicine to this one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに今日使った薬についても伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll also ask about other medicines you've used today.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ほかは、この記録のとおりです。飲んだ物と、飲む予定だった物を一緒の印にしていたので、説明を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他薬の実服用と予定の同印を説明付きで区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The other medicines are as recorded here. I used the same mark for ones I took and ones I planned to take, so I'll add an explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish actual doses of other medicines from planned doses that have the same mark by adding an explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できないことも、そのままお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell us as it is when something can't be confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。思い出せない時刻を埋めず、事実から話します。次の分とまとめてよいかも自分で決めず、案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明時刻を埋めず次回分とまとめる判断も相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't fill in times I can't remember; I'll explain the facts. I also won't decide for myself whether to combine it with the next dose; I'll listen to the guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not invent unknown times and will ask whether it can be combined with the next dose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録を分けて説明してくださりありがとうございます。それでは、薬の確認をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for explaining the records separately. Please wait while we check the medicine. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 六名様の会食のお席ですね。席札をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a dinner for six, correct? Do you have place cards?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私があだ名で作りましたが、仕事先の方も来るので、この呼び方でよいか本人に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: あだ名席札を仕事先にも見せる前に本人へ表記確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I made them using nicknames, but people from work are coming too, so I'd like to ask each person whether that name is all right.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check the nickname on each place card with its owner before showing it to work contacts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それでは、確認できるまで席札はお手元に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please keep the place cards with you until you've checked, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。今は裏返して持ちます。名前の代わりに席の番号で案内できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未確認札を伏せ席番号での案内可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'll hold them face down for now. Can we direct people by seat number instead of name?
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Keep the unconfirmed cards face down and ask whether seat numbers can be used for guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日は一番から六番までの番号をお使いいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use numbers one through six today.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 助かります。入口で全員に番号を伝えて、それぞれの席へ案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 六番号を入口で伝えて席へ案内すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: That helps. I'll tell everyone their numbers at the entrance and guide them to their seats.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will give the six numbers at the entrance and guide everyone to their seats. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 座る場所は、もうお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you already decided who will sit where?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。六人の並びは決まっています。この紙に番号を書き足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 人数と座席順は確定済で紙へ番号追加すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The seating order for all six is decided. I'll add the numbers to this paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the number of people and seating order are settled and you will add numbers to the paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お名前の表記が決まったら、必要に応じて席札を置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've settled the names to use, put out the place cards as needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。本人が希望する名前を聞いてから直します。まず番号で集まってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人希望を聞いて札を修正し当面番号で集合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll ask what name each person prefers before correcting the cards. First I'll have everyone gather by number.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will revise the cards after asking each person's preferred name and use numbers for now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、皆様で楽しいお時間をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-OGAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Have a lovely time together.

DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどの説明で、まだ気になる点はありますか。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything else from the explanation earlier that concerns you?

DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先輩はとても速く作業しています。私も同じ速さで始めないと遅いと思われそうですが、まだ手順を整理できていません。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 熟練者の速さが気になるが自身は手順未整理と申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-02.translation: The senior worker works very quickly. I'm worried I'll seem slow if I don't start at the same speed, but I haven't organized the steps in my mind yet.
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are concerned about the experienced worker's speed but have not sorted out the steps yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先輩の動きを追う前に、ご自身の分からない点を教えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before following the senior worker's movements, tell me what you don't understand.

DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 部品の名前は分かります。ただ、説明を聞いたことと、自分で順序を説明できることは違うと感じています。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 部品名理解と順序を説明できる状態を区別して述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I know the part names. But I feel that hearing an explanation and being able to explain the sequence myself are different things.
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish knowing part names from being able to explain the sequence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今は開始せず、機械を使わない確認から担当と相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't start now; let's talk to the person in charge about checking without using the machine first.

DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。先輩の後ろで同じ動きをまねて、説明を理解したことにはしません。まず図で順序を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 模倣で理解済とせず機械を使わない図の確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I won't imitate the movements behind the senior worker and count that as understanding the explanation. I'd like to check the sequence in a diagram first.
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that imitation does not establish understanding and you want to check a diagram without using the machine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どの部分で順序が分からなくなりましたか。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-07.translation: At which point did the sequence become unclear?

DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認の後に報告する相手です。作業を終えれば誰にも言わず次へ進めると思っていました。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作業後の報告先が不明で無報告で次へ進むと思ったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-08.translation: Who I should report to after checking. I thought I could finish the task and proceed to the next one without telling anyone.
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know whom to report to after the task and thought you could proceed without reporting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 報告と次の指示を受ける方法も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's also check how to report and receive the next instruction.

DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。速さのために報告を省かず、自分の理解を説明してから開始の指示を待ちます。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 報告を省かず理解確認後に開始指示を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I won't omit reporting to be faster; I'll explain my understanding and then wait for instructions to start.
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not skip reporting and will wait for start instructions after checking your understanding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認したい点が分かりました。それでは、担当と順序を確かめてください。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-GIF-SEKI-001-SHARED-11.translation: I understand what you want to check. Please confirm the sequence with the person in charge. Thank you for your effort.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作品を持ち上げた時に、何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did something happen when you lifted the piece?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の小さい作品が二つに割れました。形が似ているので、見本の棚へ戻して隠そうか一瞬思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 割れた自作品を見本棚へ紛らせようと思ったが報告すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The small piece I made broke into two. Because it looks similar, for a moment I thought about hiding it by returning it to the sample shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you considered hiding your broken piece among the samples but are reporting it instead. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 隠さず知らせてくださりありがとうございます。割れた物には触れず、場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for telling us rather than hiding it. Don't touch the broken items; tell me where they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 机の上です。まだ棚へ置いていません。見本が割れたのではなく、私が作った物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未移動の机上で他人の見本でなく自作と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the table. I haven't put it on the shelf. It wasn't a sample that broke; it was something I made.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it has not been moved from the table and is your own work rather than someone else's sample. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状態と、今後の作業について担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check its condition and what to do about further work.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。自分で接着すれば元どおりと決めず、破片を拾う方法も先に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己接着せず破片の扱いを先に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I won't assume gluing it myself would restore it; I'll also ask first how to handle the fragments.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to handle the fragments before attempting any gluing yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 残りの作業は、まだ続けていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You haven't continued the remaining work yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 止めています。失敗したから参加していないことにせず、どこまで作ったか話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作業を停止し未参加と偽らず到達段階を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've stopped. I won't pretend I didn't participate just because it went wrong; I'll explain how far I got.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that work has stopped and you will honestly explain the stage you reached rather than claim you did not participate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 作り直せるかどうかも、内容を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll also explain whether it can be remade after checking the details.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。もう一つ無料でもらえると決めず、今日は状態を説明します。見本と自分の作品を別にして扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 無料代替を決めつけず状態説明と見本区別をする旨述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't assume I'll get another one free; I'll explain the condition today. I'll keep the sample and my own work separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain the condition and distinguish your work from the sample without assuming a free replacement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へお伝えします。それでは、机から離れた場所でお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the person in charge. Please wait away from the table. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 薬味の台で、何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did something happen at the condiment counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の箸を、共有の薬味へ入れてしまいました。うどんを一口食べた後の箸です。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食後の自分箸を共用薬味へ入れたと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put my own chopsticks into the shared garnish. They were chopsticks I'd used after taking a bite of udon.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you put your used eating chopsticks into the shared garnish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのままにして、触れた容器を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Leave it as it is and tell me which container you touched.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手前のねぎです。専用の道具と取り違えました。まだ自分で中身を捨てたりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手前のねぎで専用具を誤認し中身は未廃棄と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The spring onions at the front. I mistook my chopsticks for the dedicated utensil. I haven't thrown away the contents myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it was the spring onions at the front, you mistook the dedicated utensil, and have not discarded the contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで状態と対応を確認します。箸はご自身の所でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the condition and what to do. Please keep your chopsticks at your own place.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。上の部分だけ除けばよいと判断せず、ねぎの容器全体についてお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表面だけ除去済とせず容器全体の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than decide that removing just the top would be enough, I'll report the whole spring-onion container.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the whole container to be checked rather than treat removing the surface as sufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの容器にも、その箸を入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did you put those chopsticks into any other containers?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、触れたのはねぎだけです。調味料も全部触ったと言うのでなく、実際の範囲を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他容器は未接触でねぎのみという実範囲を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, I touched only the spring onions. Rather than say I touched all the condiments too, I'll state the actual extent.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that only the spring onions were touched and no other containers were, giving the actual extent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身で拭き取ろうとせず、係にお任せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Don't try to wipe it off yourself; please leave it to staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。恥ずかしいから黙って席へ戻るより、すぐ伝えます。次は専用の道具を確認してから取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 黙って去らず店対応に任せ次回専用具を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Rather than go back to my seat silently out of embarrassment, I'll tell you right away. Next time I'll check the dedicated utensil before taking anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not leave silently, will let the restaurant handle it, and will check the dedicated utensil next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 知らせていただきありがとうございます。それでは、こちらで対応します。ご自分のお席へお戻りください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for telling us. We'll handle it here. Please return to your seat. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような場所の照明をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of place are you looking for lighting for?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 玄関です。人を感じて点く物なら便利と思いましたが、一度点いたら長く照らしてほしい時もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自動点灯が欲しいが長く点灯する希望もあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The entrance. I thought a light that turns on when it detects someone would be convenient, but sometimes I want it to stay on for longer after it lights up.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want automatic lighting but also sometimes want it to remain on longer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 点く条件と、点いている時間は分けて仕様を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check separately the conditions that turn it on and how long it stays on in the specifications.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。荷物を置く間に動かなくなっても、すぐ暗くならない物を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物置き中の静止ですぐ消えない条件を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'm looking for one that won't go dark immediately even if I stop moving while putting my bags down.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it should not switch off immediately when you stand still while setting down luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 候補の説明で設定や取扱いを確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the settings and handling in the descriptions of the candidates.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見ます。自動と書いてある物が全部同じ時間で点くとは考えず、この機種の説明を読みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自動表示を同一時間設定とせず当該機種仕様を見ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. I won't assume everything labeled automatic lights for the same amount of time; I'd like to read this model's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the automatic label does not mean identical timing and you will check this model's specifications. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取り付ける場所の条件もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the conditions at the installation location.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 雨が入ることもある玄関です。室内の写真と形が似ているだけで使えると決めず、その条件も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 雨の入る玄関条件を伝え外形類似で使用可としないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's an entrance where rain sometimes gets in. I won't decide it can be used just because its shape resembles one in an indoor photo; I'll explain that condition too.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that rain can enter the entrance and appearance alone does not establish suitability. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身で取り付けるかどうかも、案内を確認してからご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also consider whether to install it yourself only after checking the guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。今日は購入を急がず、点灯時間、場所の条件、取り付けの相談を分けて確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 点灯時間と場所と設置方法を別々に確認後選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I won't rush to buy today; I'll check the lighting duration, location conditions, and installation advice separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will choose after checking duration, location, and installation separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望に合う仕様の確認をご案内します。それでは、候補を見比べてください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll guide you through checking specifications that meet your wishes. Please compare the candidates. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどから笑顔でお話しですが、痛みの状態はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've been speaking with a smile, but how is your pain?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 痛みはあります。緊張すると笑ってしまうので、平気という意味で笑ったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 痛みはあり笑顔は緊張の反応で平気の意味ではないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am in pain. I smile when I'm nervous, so smiling didn't mean I was fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have pain and the smile is a nervous reaction, not a sign you are fine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表情だけで判断せず、お話を伺います。痛む場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll listen rather than judge from your expression alone. Please tell me where it hurts.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 腰のこの辺りです。笑った時だけの痛みではなく、座っている今も気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 腰の場所を示し笑う時だけでなく現在着座時も気になると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around here in my lower back. It doesn't hurt only when I laugh; it bothers me even now while sitting.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the lower-back location and explain that it bothers you while sitting now, not only when laughing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 痛みが変化した時は、表情とは別にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: If the pain changes, please tell us separately from your facial expression.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。さっき「大丈夫です」と言ったのは、説明を聞けるという意味でした。痛みがなくなったという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大丈夫は傾聴可能の意味で症状消失ではないと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. When I said 'I'm fine' earlier, I meant I could listen to the explanation. I didn't mean the pain had gone away.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Clarify that 'I'm fine' meant you could listen, not that the symptom had disappeared. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その意味を確認できました。痛み以外に、説明で困ることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've confirmed that meaning. Apart from pain, is anything making it difficult to explain?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: うまく話そうとして冗談を言ってしまいます。今は、言葉を選びながらゆっくり説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 冗談で補う癖を伝え言葉を選ぶ時間を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I end up making jokes while trying to explain well. Right now I'd like to explain slowly while choosing my words.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your habit of using jokes to fill gaps and ask for time to choose your words. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お急ぎにならず、分かる範囲でお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Don't rush; tell me what you can.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。楽しく笑えるから診察は不要という説明にせず、感じていることを真面目に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 笑える状態を診察不要とせず実際の感覚を真剣に説明すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I won't explain that being able to laugh means I don't need an examination; I'll seriously describe what I'm feeling.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that being able to laugh does not mean an examination is unnecessary and you will describe your actual sensations seriously. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご不安と表情の理由を伺いました。それでは、症状を確認して診察を進めましょう。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've heard your concerns and the reason for your expression. Let's check the symptoms and proceed with the examination. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遊具の近くで、何かお困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having any trouble near the play equipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない子が「もっと」と言ったので、押してあげようと思いました。でも、誰へ話した言葉か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知らない子のもっとを押す依頼と思ったが宛先不明と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: A child I don't know said 'More,' so I thought about giving them a push. But I don't know whom they were speaking to.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought an unfamiliar child's 'More' was a request to push, but do not know whom it addressed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勝手に触れず、保護者の方と状況を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't touch without asking; check the situation with their guardian.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。まだ押していません。近くの子への応援だった可能性もあるので、私への依頼とは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接触で応援の可能性もあり自己への依頼と決めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I haven't pushed yet. They might have been cheering on a nearby child, so I won't assume it was a request to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not touched anything, that it might have been encouragement, and you will not assume it was a request to you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身のお子様もご一緒ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is your own child with you too?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: うちの子は隣にいます。遊具の後ろへ一緒に入るのでなく、通路の外から様子を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の子と遊具後方へ入らず通路外から見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My child is beside me. Rather than go behind the equipment together, we'll watch from outside the passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you and your child will watch from outside the passage rather than go behind the play equipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手伝いが必要に見えても、まず声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even if it looks as though help is needed, please speak to them first.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。速くすれば喜ぶと考えず、本人と保護者に、何を望んでいるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 速さを善意で加えず本人保護者の希望を先に聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Rather than think going faster will make them happy, I'll ask the child and guardian what they want.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the child and guardian's wishes first rather than increase the speed out of goodwill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 園内の利用案内もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the park's usage guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。善意で押すことと、遊具の使い方が適切なことは別ですね。自分の子にも他人の遊具へ急に触れないと話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 利用案内を見て自分の子へ無断接触をしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Pushing with good intentions and using the equipment appropriately are separate things. I'll also tell my child not to touch equipment others are using without warning.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check usage guidance and tell your child not to touch others' equipment without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認してからの声かけをお願いします。それでは、お子様と公園をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check and speak to them first. Enjoy the park with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その封筒で発送されるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to send it in that envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。絵柄が見えるので選びました。でも、手紙の本文まで外から読めることに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 透明封筒で絵柄だけでなく本文も露出と申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I chose it because you can see the picture. But I realized the letter's text can be read from outside too.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the transparent envelope exposes not just the picture but the letter's contents too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先の表示と、中の文章を見せたいかどうかは別にお考えいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can think separately about displaying the address and whether you want the text inside to be visible.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本文は相手だけに読んでほしいです。家族の近況も書いたので、見えるまま送るつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個人近況の本文は受取人のみに読ませたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like only the recipient to read the text. I wrote family news too, so I don't intend to send it with the text visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that only the recipient should read the personal family-news text. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外側の準備や送り方について、窓口でご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can ask at the counter about the outer preparation and mailing method.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。宛名まで紙で隠すのでなく、中の文章を包む方法を考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛名を覆わず内部文面の包み方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please help. Rather than cover the address with paper too, I'd like to consider a way to wrap the text inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to wrap the inner text without covering the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 準備を変更した場合は、完成状態で取扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you change the preparation, we'll check the handling in its completed state.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。裏返しただけだと別のページが見えるので、全ての本文が外から見えないか自分でも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 裏返しだけで他頁が露出しないか全本文を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Turning it over would just expose another page, so I'll also check myself that none of the text can be seen from outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check all the text so another page is not exposed just by turning it over. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ投函していませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You haven't posted it yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 未投函です。絵を見せたい気持ちと、文章を公開したくない希望を分け、準備し直してから差し出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未投函で絵の提示希望と文章非公開を分け準備を直すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. I'll separate my wish to show the picture from my wish to keep the text private, prepare it again, and then submit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that it has not been posted, and you will distinguish showing the picture from keeping the text private and redo the preparation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 完成した状態でお持ちください。それでは、ご希望に合う包み方をご検討ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-SEKI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring it in its completed state. Consider a wrapping method that suits your wishes. Excuse me.
